label_scope: Hand-specified selection contracts, not measured physical hazards or model recall. Labels are independent of observed policy decisions.
extent_scope: Synthetic observed width/height. Only explicitly verified complete compact nuisance cases allow smallness rejection; a predicted mask alone does not prove whole-object extent.
